description: Voice rooms (4.2.0, iOS): Sew's native voice plugin's commands for the app's own window. call_details for Sew's call kit (security code, roster, quality, a ring for a window opened mid-call); not the full sew-voice:call-details set, whose ring and ring_ended would let the webview ring CallKit a second time (rings are native). The camera: its caps, cameras, on/off, front/back switch and permission, and the video sink for your own self-view (local:camera); not the full sew-voice:video set (no screen, screen_sources or preview on the phone yet)
